name: The Assistants API is shut down; move to Responses and Conversations
gain: OpenAI says the Assistants API "was officially sunset on August 26, 2026, and is no longer available".
how: Follow OpenAI's migration guide to the Responses API and Conversations API. This is a project rather than a small swap, so make it a tracked issue with written steps.
replaces: beta.assistants, beta.threads, /v1/assistants, /v1/threads and the assistants=v2 header.
trade_offs: Threads and runs have no one-line replacement, so conversation handling has to change.
The page covers OpenAI's own API; a product calling Azure OpenAI has to check Azure's docs instead.

verify_rule: The old id or parameter is gone and calls succeed over 7 days
